goals: Verify the successful upload of multiple files to a workshop via the POST API, ensuring a 201 response, correct database updates, and file storage.
activities: Insert a new workshop test record and retrieve its ID
Create two file objects associated with the workshop ID
Prepare the files payload for the API request
Send a POST request to upload the files to the workshop
Add the files to the local workshop test object
Assert the response status code is 201
Assert the response Content-Type header is application/json
Assert the response body status is 201
Assert the response body message is the expected success message
Assert the response body data matches the expected workshop data
Assert the response body detail matches the expected success details
Check the workshop data in the database by ID
Verify that both files exist in the file storage
Clean up the test environment and test files
